EC1: Diabetes mellitus [OR] or plasma glucose >11,1 at admission.
EC2: Receiving  steroids at the time of transplantation [OR] or likely to need steroids after transplantation.
EC3: Multiorgan transplants [OR] and/or previously transplanted with any other organ than kidney.
EC4: Panel reacting antibodies(PRA) >25% in most recent test [OR] or considered to be of high risk for rejection [AND] which requires an enhanced immunosuppression.
EC6: Hypersensitivity to [OR], or disability [AND] to take immunosuppressive drugs.
EC8: Unlikely to comply with the study requirements.
EC9: Transplant from donor positive for  HIV [OR], HBsAg, Hepatitis C.
EC10: Female of childbearing potential planing/being pregnant or unwilling to use contraception.
